scripts.inspect: k6 inspect tests/smoke.js && k6 inspect tests/baseline.js && k6 inspect tests/load.js && k6 inspect tests/stress.js && k6 inspect tests/spike.js && k6 inspect tests/soak.js && k6 inspect -e ENABLE_WRITES=true tests/write-interest.js
scripts.cloud:smoke: k6 cloud run --local-execution --no-archive-upload -e REQUIRE_CLOUD_PROJECT=true -e K6_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID="$K6_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID" -e BASE_URL="$BASE_URL" -e TARGET_ENV="$TARGET_ENV" -e SESSION_FILE="$SESSION_FILE" -e ALLOW_PRODUCTION_LOAD_TEST="$ALLOW_PRODUCTION_LOAD_TEST" -e PRODUCTION_MAX_VUS="$PRODUCTION_MAX_VUS" tests/smoke.js
scripts.cloud:baseline: k6 cloud run --local-execution --no-archive-upload -e REQUIRE_CLOUD_PROJECT=true -e K6_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID="$K6_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID" -e BASE_URL="$BASE_URL" -e TARGET_ENV="$TARGET_ENV" -e SESSION_FILE="$SESSION_FILE" -e ALLOW_PRODUCTION_LOAD_TEST="$ALLOW_PRODUCTION_LOAD_TEST" -e PRODUCTION_MAX_VUS="$PRODUCTION_MAX_VUS" tests/baseline.js
